contexts.text: He brought back all the substance () = that the interior man reduced all things in the external man into a state of agreement. Explained.
All who come into the other life are brought back into a similar life to that which they had in the body.
Now therefore restore the man his wife () = that he should restore the spiritual truth of doctrine untainted by the Rational.
In bringing back must I bring back thy son to the land from whence thou wentest forth? () = whether it could still be conjoined with good Divine of the Rational. Explained.
Take heed lest thou bring back my son thither () = that it could never be conjoined.
I will bring thee back to this ground () = conjunction with Divine doctrine. To bring back = to conjoin again.
They replaced the stone upon the mouth of the well in its place () = that meanwhile it was closed up.
Bring me word again () = Knowledge.
To bring him back to his father () = to claim it for the Church.
He drew back his hand () = that he hid his power.
He shall restore thee upon thy post () = that those things which are of the Sensual subject to the intellectual part shall be reduced into order, that they may be in the last place. AC 5165.

The silver that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand () = that through truth given gratis in the exterior Natural they should submit themselves as much as possible. AC 5659. AC 5757.
Truths brought back to scientifics, Signified, Explained.
If I do not bring him back to thee () = unless it be conjoined with spiritual good. To bring back = to conjoin again.

Requiting he will requite us all the evil that we have returned to him () = that punishment threatens according to merit... How the case is with the requiting of evil, or with punishments in the Spiritual World.

Jehovah brought again the waters of the sea upon them () = that the falsities from evils which they intended for the good fell back on themselves, in consequence of the presence of the Lord with those who are in good.
Bringing it back thou shalt bring it back to him () = instruction and amendment... for thus are they brought back.
Those who bring back from war () = those who have dispelled falsities.
The bringing back of the people from captivity () = the restoring of a new Church. See AE 811:28.
Those who bring back from war = those who have been in temptations and have fought against falsities.
